name: Leaderboard Arena
intro: The crowd roars for whoever ranks top.
Every player here carries a score.
In this arena, scores decide the order.

1: A board of names climbs and falls.
Every name here holds a number.
Watch the board as you work.
2: A sorted set ranks members by score.
You add a member with a score.
You read the board in order.

ok: The score updates. The crowd cheers.

curiosity: Watch the order shift as scores change.
humor: Everyone loves a good ranking fight.
Second place is just first to lose.
The board has no mercy. Neither do I.
wisdom: Scores give order. Order gives rank.
A tiny raise can leapfrog a rival.
Read the board before you bet.
sternness: No score, no rank. That is the law.
ZADD takes a number. Give it one.
